patch.summary:
Choose BambooHR only if your buying job matches “SMB/mid-market core HRIS with Core/Pro/Elite PEPM tiers — Core from $10/employee/mo above ” rather than Dayforce's shape. Choose Dayforce only if your buying job matches “AI-powered HCM (HR, pay, time, talent) with continuous payroll calculation — custom quote;” rather than BambooHR's shape. Workflow advantage: BambooHR leans core-hris, payroll-benefits; Dayforce leans enterprise-hcm. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: BambooHR is SMB/mid-market core HRIS with Core/Pro/Elite PEPM tiers — Core from $10/employee/mo above 25 employees, or $250/mo flat floor for smaller te; Dayforce is AI-powered HCM (HR, pay, time, talent) with continuous payroll calculation — custom quote; formerly Ceridian..
- Company-size focus: BambooHR (small-business, mid-market) vs Dayforce (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: BambooHR-leaning core-hris, payroll-benefits vs Dayforce-leaning enterprise-hcm.
- Researched limits: BambooHR — Payroll, benefits, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons — Core PEPM is not full HCM TCO; Dayforce — No published list price.

Limitations — BambooHR: Payroll, benefits, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons — Core PEPM is not full HCM TCO; Teams of 25 or fewer pay a $250/mo floor, so effective PEPM is far above $10; Dayforce: No published list price; Implementation is typically a large share of year-one TCO.

Poor-fit cases: BambooHR is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Payroll, benefits, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons — Core PEPM is not full HCM TCO · Dayforce is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published list price · Avoid BambooHR if you actually need Dayforce's motion (AI-powered HCM (HR, pay, time, talent) with continuous payroll calculation — cus)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
